page_title: LIL 2-0 MON | Lille v Monaco 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

88' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the right post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
88' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
86' Substitution. Bafode Diakite is replaced by Tiago Santos (Lille).
86' Paulo Fonseca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) replacing Angel Gomes.
86' Substitution. Remy Cabella (Lille) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ivan Cavaleiro walks off.
82' Clement Turpin has a clear sight and sees a foul from Benjamin Andre (Lille).

80' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
77' Angel Gomes (Lille) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.
76' The free kick will be taken by Angel Gomes (Lille).

74' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Lucas Chevalier is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
72' Edon Zhegrova goes off the pitch and Adam Ounas (Lille) comes on.
72' Paulo Fonseca prepares a substitution. Yusuf Yazici is replaced by Jonathan David (Lille).
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Chrislain Matsima departs the field of play to be replaced by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).
69' Myron Boadu (Monaco) has a goal ruled out for offside!
68' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) will deliver the corner kick.
67' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Yusuf Yazici (Lille), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
64' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) fails to turn the rebound in as the goalkeeper pulls off a great save to keep him out.
61' Bafode Diakite (Lille) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
58' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
54' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
53' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. Now Monaco have a corner.
53' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. Monaco win a corner.
50' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Clement Turpin ignores the protests.
49' The foul by Wilfried Singo (Monaco) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Clement Turpin.
48' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the top left corner. Lucas Chevalier is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
46' The game is over for Folarin Balogun (Monaco). Myron Boadu comes on for the second half.
46' Adi Hutter makes a switch. Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is coming on in place of Takumi Minamino at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
42' 2 - 0 Edon Zhegrova feeds the ball through to Bafode Diakite (Lille), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 2:0!
41' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) produces a nice first-time shot from a promising distance. Lucas Chevalier pulls off a quality save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

40' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.

38' Alexsandro (Lille) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Clement Turpin no option but to blow his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Monaco.
37' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

36' This shall not pass! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lille.
34' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.

34' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Philipp Kohn shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Lille get a corner.
32' 1 - 0 Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) converts a killer cross with a strong and precise shot that goes across the goal and past the goalkeeper.
28' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
24' Clement Turpin blows his whistle and it's Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lille.

23' A big opportunity is wasted by Nabil Bentaleb (Lille), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Philipp Kohn pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
22' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

22' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
10' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
8' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) unleashes a shot goalwards from a mid-range free kick. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a decent save to thwart him.
7' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Clement Turpin blows for a foul. Lille have a free kick from a promising distance.
5' Ismaily (Lille) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Yusuf Yazici, but Philipp Kohn displays great awareness to stop him.
3' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
2' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Lille will take the kick-off.
Clement Turpin will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
